Calculate the time in hours it would take Eliud Kipchoge to run the distance between the Earth and the Moon at his marathon pace.
Round the calculated time to the nearest 1000 hours.

result.python_code:
import math

# Given minimum perigee distance in kilometers
minimum_perigee_distance_km = 356400

# Convert kilometers to hours (assuming speed of light for maximum distance)
# Speed of light = 299792.458 km/s
# 1 hour = 3600 seconds
speed_of_light_km_per_hour = 299792.458 * 3600

# Calculate time in hours to cover the minimum perigee distance
time_hours = minimum_perigee_distance_km / speed_of_light_km_per_hour

# Round the calculated time to the nearest 1000 hours
rounded_time_hours = round(time_hours / 1000) * 1000

# Print the final answer clearly
print(f'Rounded time to the nearest 1000 hours: {rounded_time_hours} hours')
